name: mod-doom
description: Doom above the Claude Code prompt: a corridor shooter: imps, a shotgun, and the floor below. Plays while Claude works, pauses when the turn ends, keeps your best score; zero tokens. A single game split out of cc-arcade (MIT, Seza Akgün). Needs function hooks (early access) and an interactive term...
